payload.query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T09:22:37Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T09:42:37Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.1"
| STATS conns      = COUNT(*),
        bytes_out  = SUM(source.bytes),
        bytes_in   = SUM(destination.bytes),
        dest_ips   = COUNT_DISTINCT(destination.ip),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY destination.ip, destination.port, proto = network.protocol
| SORT conns DESC

questions.q: In the row where bytes_out is 1920, what is the value of destination.ip?
How many rows does this payload contain?
Which first_seen has the largest conns?
